info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Market Data By Param1-spec
info.description: The Market Data Retrieval API enables users to access detailed market data by specifying a parameter. This endpoint allows consumers to fetch relevant public reference data associated with financial markets, facilitating informed decision-making and analysis. Typical use cases include financial analysts, market researchers, and investment platforms that require timely and accurate market information. By utilizing this API, developers can seamlessly integrate market data into their applications and tools.
